props.classMechanic_text:
SYMBOLS

HOW SYMBOLS WORK

Symbols follow a set of special rules.

  • A creature may only bear one symbol at a time — if they receive a new symbol, regardless of source, any previous symbol is destroyed.

  • Symbols and their effects have unlimited duration until destroyed.

  • If a Symbolist dies, each symbol they created is immediately and automatically destroyed.

  • If a creature bearing a symbol dies, that symbol is also destroyed.

    However, if the creature is an NPC that simply changes its form and statistics when reduced to 0 Hit Points, that does not remove the symbol: the symbol is “narratively” tied to that specific character, not to their current manifestation and parameters.

  • A Villain may, during a Game Master scene, spend 1 Ultima Point to destroy any number of symbols borne by themselves and by any of their allies that are present during that scene.

    This is the only way to remove a symbol against the will of the Symbolist who created it, save for the use of an appropriate opportunity or an NPC-only Skill made by the GM (used sparingly—no more than two or three times per campaign).

  • A Symbolist may destroy any number of their symbols at any time, no action required.

  • If a symbol requires you to make a choice when it is created, that choice applies to all copies of the symbol created with that same action (it does not retroactively change copies created by previous actions).

CREATING & APPLYING SYMBOLS (SYMBOLISM)

The Symbolism Skill is how a Symbolist learns and applies symbols.

  • Learning Symbols: Each time you acquire 【💥Symbolism】, you learn two symbols.

  • Symbol Limit: You may have up to [Symbolism SL + 1] symbols active at the same time. If you would create a new symbol while at your limit, you must first choose and destroy one or more of your existing symbols.

  • Applying a Symbol: You may perform the Inventory action and spend 2 Inventory Points to create a symbol you have learned, then choose one option:

    • Apply that symbol to yourself;

    • Apply that symbol to an ally you can see;

    • Or perform a free attack with a weapon you have equipped. This attack deals no damage, but you apply a copy of the chosen symbol to each enemy hit by the attack (each copy counts as a separate symbol toward your [SL + 1] limit).

EXAMPLE

For instance, if a Symbolist applies two symbols of weakness (fire) through the Symbolism Skill, combining it with an attack with the multi (2) property, the creatures who receive those symbols will suffer extra damage from fire. If shortly afterwards the Symbolist applies a symbol of weakness (bolt) on a third creature, the two previous creatures will still receive extra damage from fire, not bolt.

REMINDER

The maximum number of symbols you may have active at the same time is based on your Skill Level (SL) in Symbolism, specifically [SL + 1].

props.class_lore:
There is great power within symbols and images, and no one knows this better than a Symbolist. Rather than a magical discipline, symbolism could be described as a study of how to weave supernatural energies into signs and icons: these may be paintings, runes, talismans and more.

Most Symbolists develop their skills through intense practice and meticulous study, but there are many who view this magical discipline as a way to freely express their artistic vision.
